question: On Passage — Secure America Act (S 2)
plain_language: This bill provides $70 billion in funding to the Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement through FY2029 for immigration enforcement, border security, and related activities. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Commit — Secure America Act (S 2)
plain_language: S. 2, the Secure America Act, provides $70 billion to the Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement through FY2029 for immigration enforcement, border security, and related activities, under budget reconciliation procedures. A motion to commit, like a motion to recommit, is the minority's last formal chance to send the bill to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it to committee; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

question: On Agreeing to the Resolution, as Amended — Expressing the support of the House of Representatives for the Department of Homeland Security (H RES 1128)
bill_title: Expressing the support of the House of Representatives for the Department of Homeland Security.
plain_language: This resolution recognizes the importance of fully funding the Department of Homeland Security. A Yea agrees to the resolution; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — BOWOW Act (H R 4638)
plain_language: This bill establishes that a non-U.S. national convicted of, or who admits to having committed, an offense related to harming animals used in law enforcement is inadmissible and deportable. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — Deporting Fraudsters Act (H R 1958)
plain_language: This bill makes certain acts related to public benefits fraud grounds for (1) barring a non-U.S. national from admission into the United States, or (2) deporting the individual. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — Relating to a national emergency by the President on February 1, 2025 (H J RES 72)
bill_title: Relating to a national emergency by the President on February 1, 2025.
plain_language: The official title of H.J.Res. 72 is “Relating to a national emergency by the President on February 1, 2025.” No official summary was available. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.
